subject: Acme - SOC 2 & audit log follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Wu <janet.wu@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - SOC 2 & audit log follow-up

Hi Janet / Liam —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the security/compliance items your InfoSec and procurement teams requested. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared
- Audit log retention and exportability (need 7+ years, export for e-discovery)
- Proof of SOC 2 scope and latest report (in-scope services, exclusions)
- Pen test evidence and remediation tracker for critical findings
- Data residency and deletion controls (DPA obligations — right to delete + customer-managed keys)
- Access logs/console audit visibility for admin actions

What Redwood can provide (summary)
- SOC 2 Type II summary + secure link to full report for review (we will provide the redacted report under NDA)
- Audit log retention configurable per account; exports in JSON/CSV and S3 delivery support
- Pen test index (report summary + scope + dates) and remediation history — we can share the high-level index today and the detailed artifacts under an NDA
- DPA template + encryption at rest/in-transit documentation; we support KMS integrations for customer key control
- Console-level audit trails: token-level and admin action logs accessible via our Console and via API

Action items / owners
1) Neha (InfoSec) — share SOC 2 package (redacted report + scope statement) via encrypted Drive link. Target: EOD tomorrow (2026-11-11).
2) Rishi (Security/Platform) — confirm pen test dates, scope, and provide the Pen Test Report Index PDF (non-sensitive summary). Target: 2026-11-12.
3) Marissa (me) — schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with your security engineers and our platform team to walk audit log exports and key management options. Proposed windows: 2026-11-13 or 2026-11-16.
4) Janet / Liam — confirm whether procurement needs the DPA redlines in parallel or after SOC 2 deliverables.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (high-level), Redwood_PenTest_Report_Index.pdf (index of reports) — I attached short stubs; we'll share full artifacts via secure link.

Thanks — appreciate the clear list of requirements today. Happy to escalate any of the above to our legal/security leaders if needed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: For reference, our SOC 2 covers our hosted inference control plane and dedicated cluster management services. We will include scope details in the package Neha sends.

From: Janet Wu <janet.wu@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>, procurement-acme <procurement@acme.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - SOC 2 & audit log follow-up

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) Retention: when you say "configurable per account," can you confirm the max retention you've supported? We need at least 7 years and the ability to produce exports in an e-discovery-friendly format.
2) SOC 2: will the redacted report include the control testing period (dates) and list of subservice orgs (e.g., any third-party infra providers)? We need to understand whether log collection/infrastructure components are in scope.
3) Pen test evidence: the procurement team typically wants the pen test date and a vulnerability remediation SLA for critical/high findings. Can you confirm how Redwood tracks remediation and whether you provide a remediation timeline?
4) Data deletion: we have strict DPA terms — we may require customer-controlled KMS. Is customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) supported for hosted deployments or only for private/on-prem offerings?

Procurement note: we may request the DPA redlines soon; if it's easier, we can do SOC 2 review first and then start DPA redlines.

If Neha/Rishi can share the SOC 2 scope and the pen test index today, that would speed the internal review. Would be great to lock the technical deep dive for Friday 11/13 at 10:00 PT if that works — we'll confirm.

—Janet
Director, Information Security | Acme Corp
janet.wu@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-9876

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Janet Wu <janet.wu@acme.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - SOC 2 & audit log follow-up

Appreciate the quick questions, Janet — short answers and next steps below.

1) Retention: we support up to 10 years of retained audit logs with export via S3 or direct CSV/JSON export. We will include an export sample in the Drive link Neha sends.

2) SOC 2: yes — the redacted report will include the control testing period and list of subservice organizations. We will redact customer-identifying info but keep scope details intact.

3) Pen test evidence: Rishi will confirm exact test dates and provide our Pen Test Report Index PDF (contains dates, high-level findings, and remediation status). Our internal SLA for remediation of critical findings is to address and verify fixes within 30 days; we'll surface exception cases where remediation required vendor coordination.

4) BYOK / KMS: we support customer-managed keys for our Private deployments today. For hosted accounts, we offer a KMS integration that provides crypto isolation and a roadmap for BYOK in Q1 2027 — we can discuss interim compensating controls in the deep dive.

Next steps (confirming owners & timelines)
- Neha: will upload the SOC 2 package (redacted report + scope statement + export sample) to the secure Drive and post the link here by 2026-11-11 EOD.
- Rishi: will upload the Pen Test Report Index and confirm dates by 2026-11-12.
- Marissa: locking the technical deep dive for Fri 2026-11-13 10:00 PT. I will send a calendar invite shortly.
- Janet/Acme: if procurement wants the DPA redlines in parallel, please let us know; otherwise we'll start DPA review after SOC 2 review.

Quoted for reference:
> On Tue, 10 Nov 2026 at 16:12 Janet Wu <janet.wu@acme.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions from our side: ...

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_PenTest_Report_Index.pdf

Thanks all — Neha and Rishi, looping you in to action items. Janet/Liam, look forward to the deep dive on Friday.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
